details.biography:
Jacob's Well (first Keepers) · Seat 1, Front line

Six winters on the Boldock Wall taught you that the dark beyond the firelight is full of things that want in. You took the Keepers' coin to see the world past the Red Waste. You have never shared a fire with an orc and you are not sure you can start now.

Tonight: There is an orc chieftain in the common room, and the house rules say no fighting.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Weapon Specialisation (longsword). Advantage on the first attack roll you make with it each round, and +1 damage (already in the line above).

Combat Manoeuvres. You can use every manoeuvre in the Codex (Trip, Disarm, Shove, Shield Blow, Guard and the rest). Your own: Intimidating Strike, on a hit the target makes a Will save (DC 14) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

Manoeuvre Mastery. Manoeuvres that would give your own attack Disadvantage (Shield Blow) are rolled normally.

Battle Space. You count as flanking a creature whenever an ally is also in melee with it, not only from opposite sides.

Combat Reflexes (free feat). Once per round, an Attack of Opportunity against an enemy you can see that leaves your reach or moves past or through it. Disengage prevents it.

Toughness (Human bonus feat). +1 HP a level and +1 Constitution (both included), and Advantage on Constitution checks.

Shield Expert (feat, 1st). +1 AC with a shield (included), and your shield bonus adds to Reflex saves (included).

Mighty Deed of Arms (feat, 3rd). Once per round, call your shot and roll a d4 with the attack. On a hit and a 3 or 4: knock Prone, disarm, push 10ft, blind until the end of its next turn, or give it Disadvantage on its next attack. Save DC 14 (Fortitude for prone, push or disarm; Reflex for blind; Will for the penalty). A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

Kit: Boldock Wall Guard. Waste-Hardened: creatures with the Orc ancestry tag have Disadvantage on their first attack roll against you each round, and can't make you Frightened. Wall Authority: Advantage on Perception checks on watch or guard duty.

Human. Advantage on Tracking checks (chosen skill). You picked up Orcish on the Wall, listening to raiders across the ditch.

Armour Class on the sheet: Scale mail +4, Dex +1, wooden shield +1, Shield Expert +1

Class Abilities

1st Level

  • Weapon Specialisation: Choose one weapon — you have Advantage on the first attack roll you make with it each round, and gain +1 damage with it.
  • Improves to +2 damage at 7th level, +3 at 13th and +4 at 19th
  • Weapon Training: your specialised weapon gives you its own manoeuvre, used once per round as part of a hit (still one rider per hit):
    • Bind (blades): make a Disarm contest against the target.
    • Hew (axes, maces, hammers and flails): a creature your size or smaller makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
    • Hook (spears and polearms): make a Trip contest against the target, at your weapon's full reach.
    • Pinning Fire (bows and crossbows): the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll.
  • Combat Manoeuvres: Every character can use every manoeuvre; the Fighter's edge is its own manoeuvres (Weapon Training, Armour Training, Fighter Manoeuvres) and Manoeuvre Mastery. See the Combat Manoeuvres section for details.
  • Combat Reflexes: You have the Combat Reflexes feat for free (see The Feats of Arneyan in Character Creation). It doesn't use a feat slot.

2nd Level

  • Manoeuvre Mastery: Manoeuvres that impose disadvantage on your own attack roll (Shield Blow) are now rolled normally, with no disadvantage.
  • 9th level: you learn the other two Fighter Manoeuvres.
  • 13th level: manoeuvres that previously imposed disadvantage on your attack roll are now rolled with advantage instead.

3rd Level

  • Battle Space: You control the space around you in ways most fighters never learn.
  • You count as flanking a creature whenever an ally is also in melee with it, not only when directly opposite
  • 13th level: +1 AC unless wielding a two-handed weapon, and a Flank Attack also pushes the target 5ft
  • 17th level: a Flank Attack also deals +1 damage die
  • 22nd level: when you attack, you may also Disengage from any number of enemies as part of the same action; you have Advantage on Reflex saves; and a Flank Attack deals +2 damage dice instead, and its target can't make Attacks of Opportunity against you until the start of your next turn
  • Armour Training: you ignore the Cumbersome, Hot and Bulky traits and the Tower Shield's speed loss (Noisy still applies).
  • You also gain the Immovable manoeuvre: in medium or heavy armour, a creature no more than one size larger than you can't push or shove you, knock you Prone or otherwise move you against your will.
  • Once per round, out of turn, a creature that tries is knocked Prone instead.

4th Level

  • Press the Advantage: once per round, when you hit with a melee attack, you may also make one contest manoeuvre (Trip, Disarm or Dirty Trick) against that creature as part of the hit.
  • Fighter Manoeuvres: you learn two of the four Fighter Manoeuvres (see Combat Manoeuvres, below), and the other two at 9th. Each is used once per round, on a hit, and improves at 13th.

5th Level

  • Press On: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage if your first attack hit.
  • After the extra attack, you may make one Trip, Disarm or Dirty Trick contest, or one Fighter Manoeuvre if it hit, against the same target for free; it doesn't count as your once per round.

6th Level

  • Legend of Battle: Once per encounter, as part of the action you use to attack, your first attack that turn has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits, with no rolling.
  • 13th level: every attack that turn has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits
  • 20th level: lasts 1 minute, and enemies that can see you must make a Will save (Class Save DC) at the start of each of their turns or be frightened for 1 round

7th Level

  • Unbroken: Once per day, when reduced to 0 HP or below, immediately stand at 1 HP.
  • No save, no check: pure will
  • 24th level: once per encounter instead; for the next round you have Resistance 10 to all damage and your attacks deal +2 damage dice, then normal rules resume

8th Level

  • Hold Ground: Once per round, out of turn, when an enemy ends its move within your reach, you may move 5ft without provoking, and its first attack before your next turn has Disadvantage if you're now next to an ally.

13th Level

  • Combat Dominance: as your action, make one attack against each creature within your reach whose Level is no more than half yours. These attacks have no Advantage or Disadvantage from any source, and nothing adds an attack to them: no Press On, off-hand attack or Flowing Strikes.

15th Level

  • Strength Bonus: Gain a permanent +1 to Strength.

19th Level

  • Attribute Bonus: Gain a permanent +1 to either Strength or Dexterity.

20th Level

  • Renown: Hold: You may found a keep or garrison (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d6 soldiers (Level 0) and one 1st-level Fighter join it. While you hold it, you have Drilled Ranks: an ally who trains for a week at your Hold knows one of your Fighter Manoeuvres while in your service.

Combat Manoeuvres

Every manoeuvre in the Combat Manoeuvres section is available to the Fighter from 1st level.

  • The Fighter also has manoeuvres of its own: a weapon manoeuvre (Weapon Training, 1st), Immovable (Armour Training, 3rd) and the four Fighter Manoeuvres below, two learned at 4th and the other two at 9th.
  • Each is used once per round, on a hit, and improves at 13th.
ManoeuvreEffect
Intimidating StrikeThe target makes a Will save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn. 13th: every enemy within 5ft of you saves.
Drive BackPush the target 5ft and step into the space it left. 13th: 10ft.
Bar the WayUntil your next turn, the target can't move past you without a Reflex save. 13th: nor can any enemy within 5ft of you.
Feint and StrikeYour next attack against the target this round has Advantage. 13th: so does an ally's next attack against it.

Once per round, make an Attack of Opportunity (one melee attack) against an enemy you can see that leaves your melee reach or moves past or through it. Disengage prevents it.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

Open to all classes by default.

+1 AC while wielding a shield, and add your shield's AC bonus to Reflex saves.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

Once per round, call your shot before you attack, in melee or at range.

  • Roll a d4 alongside your attack; if the hit lands and the d4 comes up 3 or better, choose one: knock the target Prone, disarm it, push it 10ft (5ft with a ranged attack), blind it until the end of its next turn, or give it Disadvantage on its next attack.
  • The target resists with a save against your Class Save DC, using Strength or Dexterity, whichever is higher: Fortitude against Prone, a push or a disarm, Reflex against blinding, Will against the attack penalty.
  • A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.
  • You can also make Called Shots (see Combat Manoeuvres in The Arneyan Codex).

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

activities.name: Deed die (1d4)
activities.text: Roll alongside your attack: on a hit with 3 or better, choose a deed.

activities.name: Prone, push or disarm
activities.text: Knock it Prone, push it 10ft (5ft with a ranged attack) or disarm it, unless it passes a Fortitude save. A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

activities.name: Blind
activities.text: Blind it until the end of its next turn, unless it passes a Reflex save. A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

activities.name: Attack penalty
activities.text: Disadvantage on its next attack, unless it passes a Will save. A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.
